name: humanizer-en
description: Edit or review existing English prose when asked to humanize it, remove AI tone, or improve readability and naturalness. Repair sentences that force rereading and trim formulaic prose while preserving claims, evidence, genre, dialect, and the writer's voice. Works on selected passages or full drafts.
